title: Neighborhood Name Change
synopsis: Chinese provinces have started a standardization process for “big, foreign, strange and repetitive” place names.

fullText.simplified:
你家的小区改名了吗？

    你家的小区叫什么名字？不知道你周围的小区有没有叫“维多利亚花园”、“夏威夷海岸”等名字的？那这些小区可能要被改名了。
    最近，海南、广东、宁夏、山西、浙江、山东、四川等全国多个省份开始对居民区、大型建筑物和道路等地名中存在的“大、洋、怪、重”等不规范地名，进行规范化、标准化处理。其中，“大、洋、怪、重”分别是指：地名含义、类型或规模方面刻意夸大的“大”地名，比如“台州1号”；以外国人名、地名以及使用外语词及其汉字译写形式命名的“洋”地名，比如“加州阳光小区”；盲目追求怪诞离奇，地名用字不规范、含义低级庸俗或带有浓重封建色彩的“怪”地名，比如“水晶卡芭拉小区”；一定区域范围内多个地名重名或同音的“重”地名。
    实际上关于地名的争议在国内早就存在，楼盘项目名尤为瞩目。近年来，房地产经济迅猛发展，为了房子好卖，取个好名字是最简单的招数。因为好名字往往代表着好销量、高房价。那怎么给楼盘取个好名字呢？楼盘名带上外国地名，是开发商最喜欢的一种取名方式。在小小的县城里面，怎么寻找国外度假的感觉呢？没有什么比住在“东方巴黎”、“金色维也纳”、“海上威尼斯”更带感的了。但这样的地名，以后都不会出现在开展地名整改工作的省份了。
    对于这样的地名整改，网上的评价褒贬不一。有些人认为整改很好，那些夸大事实，特别是崇洋媚外的名字，就不应该出现；而有些人则担心小区更换名称以后，地址变了，就需要更换身份证和房产证等，会很麻烦。
fullText.traditional:
你家的小區改名了嗎？

    你家的小區叫什麼名字？不知道你周圍的小區有沒有叫“維多利亞花園”、“夏威夷海岸”等名字的？那這些小區可能要被改名了。
    最近，海南、廣東、寧夏、山西、浙江、山東、四川等全國多個省份開始對居民區、大型建築物和道路等地名中存在的“大、洋、怪、重”等不規範地名，進行規範化、標準化處理。其中，“大、洋、怪、重”分別是指：地名含義、類型或規模方面刻意誇大的“大”地名，比如“台州1號”；以外國人名、地名以及使用外語詞及其漢字譯寫形式命名的“洋”地名，比如“加州陽光小區”；盲目追求怪誕離奇，地名用字不規範、含義低級庸俗或帶有濃重封建色彩的“怪”地名，比如“水晶卡芭拉小區”；一定區域範圍內多個地名重名或同音的“重”地名。
    實際上關於地名的爭議在國內早就存在，樓盤項目名尤為矚目。近年來，房地產經濟迅猛發展，為了房子好賣，取個好名字是最簡單的招數。因為好名字往往代表著好銷量、高房價。那怎麼給樓盤取個好名字呢？樓盤名帶上外國地名，是開發商最喜歡的一種取名方式。在小小的縣城裡面，怎麼尋找國外度假的感覺呢？沒有什麼比住在“東方巴黎”、“金色維也納”、“海上威尼斯”更帶感的了。但這樣的地名，以後都不會出現在開展地名整改工作的省份了。
    對於這樣的地名整改，網上的評價褒貶不一。有些人認為整改很好，那些誇大事實，特別是崇洋媚外的名字，就不應該出現；而有些人則擔心小區更換名稱以後，地址變了，就需要更換身份證和房產證等，會很麻煩。

raw.synopsis: Chinese provinces have started a standardization process for “big, foreign, strange and repetitive” place names.
sentence_translations: Has the name of your home neighborhood changed?
What is your home neighborhood called?
Perhaps your surroundings have neighborhoods called “Victoria Garden”, “Hawaiian Coast”, or some name like that?
In that case, the names of these neighborhoods might be changed.
Recently, the provinces and autonomous regions of Hainan, Guangdong, Ningxia, Shanxi, Zhejiang, ..
.. Shandong, Sichuan and many other provinces all over the country, ..
.. have started, for place names of things like residential areas, large-scale buildings and roads, ..
.. that have irregular place names with “big, foreign, strange, repetitive” and so on in them, ..
.. carrying out a regularization and standardization process.
Among these, “big, foreign, strange and repetitive” are separately referring to:
“Big” place names that are deliberately exaggerating its aspects with implied meaning, type or scale of the place name.
For example "Taizhou no.1";
Those that by means of foreign personal names, place names ..
.. as well as use words from a foreign language and forms of Chinese transliterations to name them “foreign” place names.
For example the “California Sunshine Neighborhood”;
Place names that are blindly pursuing the weird and bizarre, using irregular words with vulgar and tacky connotations, ..
.. or have a strong tint of feudalism, the “strange” place names like for example the “Crystal Kabala Neighborhood”;
”Repetitive” place names where many place names in the range of a certain region have the same or same-sounding names.
In fact, disputes concerning place names came into being long ago in this country.
Especially placing the focus of attention on real estate projects.
With the coming of recent years, the real estate economy has developed quickly and violently.
In order for an apartment to sell easily, taking a good name was the simplest move.
This owing to that a good name often represents good sales volume and high house prices.
Then how do you pick a good name for real estate?
Giving real estate a foreign name, is the naming style that developers like the most.
In very small county towns, how can you pursuit the feeling of spending a vacation abroad?
Nothing is more affecting compared to living in “Eastern Paris”, “Golden Vienna” or “Maritime Venice”.
But these kinds of place names, ..
.. won’t appear in the future in the provinces that have launched into work with the place name reform.
Regarding the reform of these kinds of place names, the online comments and appraisals vary.
Some people believe that the reform is very good.
Those that exaggerate reality, especially names that are blind worship of foreign goods and ideas, just shouldn't appear;
But in contrast, some people worry that after neighborhoods have had their names changed, ..
.. and the addresses have changed, they will need to have their identity cards and title deeds and so on changed, ..
.. and that will be very inconvenient.
